columns.seq_id: Stable identifier. BPS* for positives (internal), UniProt accession for negatives.
columns.split: train | val | test | unused. 'unused' rows are PHA depolymerases that carry no claim; they are not a held-out test and were never used for training, tuning or evaluation.
columns.label: 1 = polyester degrader, 0 = negative.
columns.negative_group: For negatives only. ab_hydrolase_hard_negative | ec311_wrong_fold | trna_processing | naive_control. USE THIS, not class_label.
columns.class_label: Legacy label kept only for cross-referencing published results. '3_fold_matched_esterase' is a misnomer: only 50 of its 185 members carry the fold.
columns.component: Homology component id. Sequences in one component share >=40% identity. BOOTSTRAP OVER THIS COLUMN, never over individual proteins.
columns.cluster: Finer identity cluster inside a component.
columns.substrates: Pipe-separated plastics the enzyme is reported to degrade (positives only).
columns.activity_verified: 1 = degradation measured in the literature; 0 = reported but not independently confirmed.
columns.ab_hydrolase_fold: 1 if UniProt/InterPro IPR029058 (alpha/beta hydrolase fold). Blank where no UniProt accession exists.
columns.gxsxg_elbow: 1 if the sequence contains the G-x-[ST]-x-G nucleophile elbow motif.
columns.n_curated_active_sites: Count of curated UniProt ACT_SITE residues (negatives only).
columns.phylum: Source phylum. Positives are 72.6% Actinomycetota; negatives were drawn to match.
